name: People Ops, Talent Calibration & Workforce Analytics
description: Calibrates structured interview scorecards for score dispersion and bias signals, orchestrates 30/60/90 onboarding plans with mandatory Day-1 gate checks, and audits effective-dated Workday compensation bands with FTE/CWK separation and small-cell privacy redaction.

skills.summary: Audits 1-4 interview scorecards for >=2.0 dispersion, thin behavioral evidence (<40 chars), and protected-class bias signals.
Tracks 30/60/90 onboarding milestones, enforces mandatory Day-1 IT/security gates, and detects blocked upstream dependencies.
Deduplicates effective-dated HRIS rows, isolates CWKs from FTEs, normalizes hourly/monthly/FX pay, and suppresses <5 privacy cells.

byo_mcp: Workday HRIS & ATS Scorecard MCP server
connectors.connector_fetch_guidance: Retrieve effective-dated employee compensation rosters, contingent-worker flags, interview scorecards, and onboarding task gates from Google Sheets/ServiceNow or customer Workday/ATS MCP servers via remote_cli mcp before Python HR analytics.

gateway_approval_actions: Proposing or committing compensation adjustments in customer Workday HRIS MCP
Advancing candidate offer stages or dispatching hiring letters via customer ATS MCP / Gmail
python_code_guardrails: Strict small-cohort n < min_privacy_group_size (n < 5) k-anonymity salary & attrition redaction
Effective-date deduplication, Contingent Worker (CWK) isolation from FTE totals, and EUR/GBP monthly FX normalization
Scorecard bias/halo variance alert preventing autonomous hiring recommendations
